attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "This revert reintroduces a semaphore-based locking scheme (SemaphoreSlim held for the full build duration, including per-tenant re-check) instead of the per-key ILocalLock approach, which was presumably replaced to fix a real concurrency/caching bug, so reverting risks reintroducing shape table build contention/deadlock issues across tenants under load."}

reason: This revert reintroduces a semaphore-based locking scheme (SemaphoreSlim held for the full build duration, including per-tenant re-check) instead of the per-key ILocalLock approach, which was presumably replaced to fix a real concurrency/caching bug, so reverting risks reintroducing shape table build contention/deadlock issues across tenants under load.
